-- Data page made by sync_wiki_data.py (Skills). Do not edit by hand, it is overwritten when the script runs.
return {
	[17092] = { cd = "30s", desc = "Increases Pet Move Speed |cFFFF9C27+50%|r for 10s.\nCan't be used while carrying a trade pack.", icon = "icon_skill_snowlion05.png", mana = 20, name = "Run!" },
	[17097] = { cd = "15s", desc = "Heals pet's health +#{min_heal}-#{max_heal}.", icon = "icon_skill_battle_pet02.png", mana = 0, name = "Health Regen" },
	[17152] = { cd = "30s", desc = "Triggers a forward charge for 3s that makes you invincible. Can't be used while carrying a trade pack.", icon = "icon_skill_wild03.png", mana = 0, name = "Dash" },
	[17155] = { cd = "12s", desc = "Fires a burning arrow to deal +|cFFFF9C27500%|r of Ranged Attack as Physical Damage; also deals +|cFFFF9C27200%|r of Ranged Attack as damage over |cFFFF9C275 seconds|r.", icon = "icon_skill_wild06.png", mana = 0, name = "Mounted Fire Arrow" },
	[17159] = { cd = "30s", desc = "Teleports the rider |cFFFF9C2718 meters|r forward, out of the saddle.\nCan't be used while carrying a trade pack.", icon = "icon_skill_will11.png", mana = 0, name = "Owner's Escape" },
	[17284] = { cd = "18s", desc = "Excited, your pet achieves |cFFFF9C27+1,000|r more Attack Speed for 12s.\nRight-click to auto-use.", icon = "icon_skill_battle_pet03.png", mana = 0, name = "Berserk" },
	[17388] = { cd = "24s", desc = "Triggers a charge that can Stun a distant enemy for 2s.\nCan't be used while carrying a trade pack.", icon = "icon_skill_wild13.png", mana = 0, name = "Overrun" },
	[17391] = { cd = "18s", desc = "Triggers a |cFFFF9C2712 m|r backwards leap to escape danger.\nCan't be used while carrying a trade pack.", icon = "icon_skill_passive01.png", mana = 20, name = "Drop Back" },
	[17394] = { cd = "24s", desc = "Shoots an arrow a great distance and deals damage equal to |cFFFF9C27700%|r of your Ranged Attack.", icon = "icon_skill_vocation12.png", mana = 0, name = "Snipe" },
	[17398] = { cd = "1m", desc = "Increases the pet's and rider's Attack +|cFFFF9C2730%|r for 30s.\nCanceled if you dismount.", icon = "icon_skill_romance20.png", mana = 0, name = "Anabolica" },
	[17399] = { cd = "15s", desc = "Triggers a long, elegant leap |cFFFF9C2725 m|r forward.\nCan't be used while carrying a trade pack.", icon = "icon_skill_horseback11.png", mana = 0, name = "Elegant Leap" },
	[17698] = { cd = "15s", desc = "Hastens the caster, allowing them to dash into enemies and deal #{avg_damage} Physical Damage with a chance to Trip for 2s.\nRight-click to activate auto-use.", icon = "icon_skill_wild13.png", mana = 0, name = "Overrun" },
	[17701] = { cd = "6s", desc = "Strengthens pet's scratch to deal #{avg_damage} Physical Damage.\nRight-click to activate auto-use.", icon = "icon_skill_passive02.png", mana = 0, name = "Scratch" },
	[17702] = { cd = "15s", desc = "Restores #{avg_heal} of pet's health.\nRight-click to activate auto-use.", icon = "icon_skill_battle_pet06.png", mana = 0, name = "Health Regen" },
	[17704] = { cast = "1s", cd = "15s", desc = "Taunts an enemy to turn its face to you.\nRight-click to activate auto-use.", icon = "icon_skill_fight05.png", mana = 0, name = "Guard Dog" },
}
